arrangement.notes: Minimal trip hop arrangement with cinematic mood and hook-heavy energy profile. Samples are segmented into micro chops, phrase chops, reverse chops, vocal chops, and stutter chops to build texture and dynamics.

event_markers.label: hook_start
event_markers.reason: begin hook section with hook-heavy vocal chops

event_markers.label: bridge_entry
event_markers.reason: introduce bridge section variation in sample chops

event_markers.label: final_hook_start
event_markers.reason: introduce final hook with increased energy and chops variation

track_roles.vocal: vocal chops focused on hooks and stutters
track_roles.fx: atmospheric effects using reverse and stutter chops

sensei_drum.brief: Generate rhythm parts emphasizing various drum chops for groove and texture, focusing on segmented micro, phrase, and reverse chops.

bass_generator.brief: Provide minimalistic bass patterns that complement the groove and maintain low energy during verses and increased presence during hooks.

harmony_generator.brief: Create chordal pads and texture using phrase chops that maintain the cinematic mood with minimal harmonic movement.

melody_generator.brief: Develop sparse melodic motifs from micro chopped samples to add subtle melodic interest without overpowering the arrangement.

ai_designer.brief: Design overall arrangement structure ensuring energy profile is hook-heavy with smooth transitions across sections.

presetor.brief: Assign and apply appropriate presets emulating sample chops techniques including micro, phrase, reverse, vocal, and stutter chops.

songgps.brief: Manage arrangement markers and energy curve aligning with trip hop minimal cinematic style.

ai_mixmaster.brief: Balance and mix subverse layers maintaining clarity and dynamic contrast between hooks and verses.
